prompt: Add a self-contained budget demo to examples/budget.html using petite-vue and two local transactions (Food $12.50, Travel $7.25). Put its styles in examples/budget.css and link to the page from index.html. A Food button filters the list and its visible total to $12.50; an All button restores both entries and the $19.75 total. Show each total as its own text value. Do not fetch data, add dependencies, or use external assets. Run a browser check.
